title: The Confession of the Marlowe Estate
author: Beatrix Halloran
blurb: Isandro Coldharbour, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the trial begins.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
